nodes.label: Git Branch Model (main/preview/feature)
nodes.rationale: main and preview are both protected; all feature branches must be cut from preview, never main, to keep preview always deployable and main only updated via reviewed PRs from preview.

nodes.label: Decision Boundaries (stop-and-ask rules)
nodes.rationale: Agents must stop and ask before touching API contracts, multi-file tasks, new dependencies, or ambiguous approaches, to avoid silent scope creep in an AI-assisted codebase.

nodes.label: Planning Protocol (/execute-task)
nodes.rationale: All structured multi-file work must flow through /execute-task to enforce read-plan-approve-implement-summarize-commit, preventing ungoverned changes.

nodes.label: Doppler Secret Injection
nodes.rationale: All commands must use doppler run -- to inject secrets at runtime instead of raw .env files, preventing secret leakage and ad hoc exports.

nodes.label: LLM_PROVIDER Feature Flag
nodes.rationale: Switches between groq and anthropic without hardcoding a provider, routed through backend/llm/client.py abstraction layer.

nodes.label: Git Hygiene Rules
nodes.rationale: One commit per logical change (not per file) keeps history reviewable; conventional commits and no AI co-authors keep authorship clear.

nodes.label: Severity Schema (routine|moderate|urgent|emergent)
nodes.rationale: Canonical four-value severity scale; synonyms like critical/severe/high/low are explicitly banned to keep one source of truth across frontend and backend.

nodes.label: Auth Architecture (client-side Supabase Auth + backend JWT verify)
nodes.rationale: Supabase Auth is called directly from the React client for both email and Google so FastAPI never sees credentials, only JWTs; FastAPI verifies the JWT per-request via a reusable dependency with no server-side session, keeping the backend stateless.

nodes.label: ETag conditional response (RFC 7232)
nodes.rationale: ETag prevents redundant data transfer on subsequent fetches when data hasn't changed; Cache-Control: no-cache forces revalidation while letting 304 short-circuit the body.

nodes.label: Map loading spinner (cold-start load-bearing)
nodes.rationale: Render free tier cold starts bypass the warm in-memory cache because the process restarts, so the spinner is functionally necessary, not decorative.

nodes.label: Facility marker SVG icon (cross, Option B)
nodes.norm_label: facility marker svg icon (cross, option b)

nodes.label: Sentry maskAllText PII masking
nodes.rationale: maskAllText is non-negotiable for a health app — symptom text entered by users must never appear in Sentry session replays, a HIPAA-conscious default.

nodes.label: Row Level Security policies (profile_select_own, profile_update_own)
nodes.rationale: Users can only read/update their own profile row; inserts are handled by a service-role trigger only, so there is no client insert policy needed.

nodes.norm_label: task 008: chat — backend api + frontend integration

nodes.label: Stub assistant response (first 50 chars)
nodes.rationale: LLM integration is deferred to task 009 — the assistant response is a deterministic stub so the chat plumbing (sessions, messages, cache, ETag) can be verified independently of any model call.

nodes.label: Writer-updates-cache pattern
nodes.rationale: Per-user chat cache is updated inline whenever a message is written, avoiding a full Supabase re-fetch after every send.

nodes.label: Task 008 (LLM doc): LLM Triage Agent — Symptom Classification + Facility Tool
nodes.norm_label: task 008 (llm doc): llm triage agent — symptom classification + facility tool

nodes.label: Two-pass LLM design (classify then ground)
nodes.rationale: Pass 1 classifies severity with no facility knowledge to avoid hallucination risk; pass 2 generates a grounded response with the real facility name injected from the deterministic proximity tool, so the LLM can never invent a facility.

nodes.label: Task 010 (doc id 009): Triage UI — Map Route Display + Chat Triage Result
nodes.norm_label: task 010 (doc id 009): triage ui — map route display + chat triage result

nodes.label: Geoapify RouteMatrix ETA re-ranking
nodes.rationale: Backend recommends the nearest facility by Haversine distance; the frontend re-ranks by Geoapify drive-time ETA so the true recommendation reflects real-world travel time, not straight-line distance.

nodes.label: Next-action buttons legal note (user-initiated only)
nodes.rationale: Call 911 / message emergency contact / get directions are deliberately stubbed as user-tap-only actions; the app must never autonomously dial or send to avoid liability and false emergencies.

nodes.norm_label: task: mobile responsive ui — small screen experience

nodes.label: 768px breakpoint mobile/desktop split strategy
nodes.rationale: Desktop split-pane layout (map left, chat right) is unusable below 768px, so a dedicated tab-based mobile layout is introduced without restructuring or regressing the existing desktop JSX.

nodes.label: Push install/permission state machine
nodes.rationale: Full state machine (unknown→detecting→needs_install→installing→installed→needs_permission→requesting→granted→token_captured→registered) is required because iOS standalone-only push, Android optional-install push, and desktop in-tab push all have different install/permission prerequisites.

nodes.label: iOS 16.4+ push support constraint
nodes.rationale: Web Push is only supported on iOS Safari 16.4+ and only when the PWA is installed to the home screen (standalone) — below that version, push must show an unsupported message rather than a permission prompt.

nodes.label: Render deploy webhook (commented out)
nodes.rationale: The deploy-backend job that triggers the Render deploy hook is commented out, with a parallel skip-backend job active instead — backend auto-deploy on preview push is not yet enabled.

nodes.label: Radius token naming collision fix (stratum- prefix)
nodes.rationale: Bare --radius-sm/md/lg/xl names collided with Tailwind v4's built-in default radius scale keys, which would have silently changed 39 existing rounded-sm/md/lg/xl usages across 14 files; renamed to stratum-prefixed tokens to avoid the collision before those components are re-skinned.
nodes.norm_label: radius token naming collision fix (stratum- prefix)

nodes.label: Tailwind v4 @theme tree-shaking behavior
nodes.rationale: Tailwind v4 drops @theme custom property declarations entirely (not just utility classes) when nothing in source references them, so most new tokens correctly do not appear in compiled CSS until consumed by later sub-projects.

nodes.label: Unified severity schema (routine|moderate|urgent|emergent)
nodes.rationale: Adopted as canonical schema for all layers because it aligns with standard emergency triage terminology (ESI, CTAS), was already used in backend training data and cloud function, and 'urgent'/'emergent' read correctly to health tech reviewers vs colloquial 'critical'/'severe'.

nodes.label: Groq default provider choice
nodes.rationale: Groq preferred for free tier; Anthropic Claude offers higher quality at cost per token. Provider abstraction lets the choice change as the project scales without code changes — only a Doppler config change and Render redeploy.

nodes.label: Severity schema mismatch (frontend vs backend)
nodes.rationale: Frontend uses critical/severe/moderate/routine; backend training data and cloud function use routine/moderate/urgent/emergent — two halves of the system never actually talk to each other, surfaced as the reason for ADR-001.

nodes.rationale: 8 commented-out attempts to find correct endpoint URL format for Vertex AI endpoint 8775805933163905024; prediction call format differs from training data schema; deployed function substitutes random.choice() for model inference.

nodes.label: Hardcoded Geoapify API key
nodes.rationale: Geoapify API key hardcoded as plaintext in client-side source (geoapify.ts), making it publicly visible in any deployed build — flagged as a security issue in the audit.
